title: Request equipment for an event
note: Jira SPM-57 AC1-AC11 and SPM-148 AC1/R1 are the requirements. Confluence matrix 28147868 lists PRIMARY IDs EQUIP-REQUEST-01..10 and case pages 28180612, 28180629, 28180646, 28082317, 28016850, 28180663, 28016867, 28180680, 28147879, and 28868822. AC10 cases were approved in chat on 2026-10-17; AC11 clarification was confirmed by the user on 2026-10-17. AC11 allows only one request per event; later changes use Update Event to replace item details within the same request and retain its reference. AC9 still transitions Approved to Planning on the first equipment request and leaves an already-Planning event unchanged. AC3 was changed by Confluence change record 28442627 (https://is212-g5-t2.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SP/pages/28442627): equipment name replaces technical requirements and is required, nonblank, and trimmed following SPM-111 name semantics; maintenance status and location are not request fields. The existing equipment API type list is authoritative for currently supported request types. Jira AC4 defines no business upper quantity limit; positive whole-number quantities up to 2,147,483,647 are supported solely as the PostgreSQL signed 32-bit integer storage/API representability boundary, not as a product cap. SC-004 is DECIDED in favor of AC11.
